note: WebFetch could not resolve host names in this session and the shared web search allowance ran out after about twenty searches, so pages were read with the kit's own fetcher (states/net.py, honest User-Agent). Past runs under a party label come from the Secretary of State's own elections database (historicalelectiondata.coloradosos.gov, contest pages citing the State Abstract of Votes Cast). Judges' official pages are the Colorado Judicial Branch's own pages for each judge (name, title, court, county); the Office of Judicial Performance Evaluation's site answered this tool with 403 and was not read, so no appointment years are given. Party lists that do not say 'endorsed' (Libertarian Party of Colorado's candidates page for Barr and Joss, the Colorado Center Party's page for Tim Martin, the Colorado GOP's candidates page, county voter guides) are support, not endorsements (see ballot/lean/co_endorsements.json), and are not recorded here; Joss's 'HD48 LPCO Website' sits on the party's own site and is not a campaign website. Ken deGraaf's campaign site answered 403 and reinforcolorado.com's About page answered 429, so deGraaf has no website here and David Rein's Lakewood City Council seat is not recorded (the council's own page names a David Rein, Ward 4, first elected November 2023, but no page read ties him to the House District 28 race). Sitting legislators (deGraaf, Hartsook, Slaugh, Sullivan) were checked for a website only. Blank means not found, not that nothing exists.
verifier_note: Every url re-opened with the kit's fetcher (honest User-Agent). Corrected: Dayna L. Vise: from 2024 added from the official page's Bio; Jacob A. Edson: from 2023 added from the official page's Bio.
